visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman in a white t-shirt sitting on a wooden floor in a living room. She is holding a large, pink Pop Mart blind box titled 'WILD & CUTIE'. She smiles broadly and speaks directly to the camera. Behind her is a grey fabric sofa with a blue elephant plush toy sitting on it. The lighting is bright and even. (2) She begins tearing the outer plastic and opening the large box lid with visible excitement. She reaches inside to reveal several smaller blind boxes. The camera stays static as she removes the inner packaging, showing her hands handling the items. She pulls out individual blind boxes and continues the unboxing process. (3) A series of shots follows where she holds different plush cat dolls close to the camera. Each doll has a unique color, such as brown leopard print, olive green, cream white, soft pink, blue/grey leopard, and purple, and features oversized 'tears' coming from the eyes. She rotates them to show the fur texture and details while smiling. (4) Finally, she stacks all six plushies into a pyramid in front of her on the floor. She leans in close to the collection, looking happy. The video cuts to a final still image of the stacked dolls against a dark background, with stylized Traditional Chinese text overlays naming each specific cat variant.
